tasks.detail:
Innovation scans from Oct 8-10 show qwen2.5:3b (99% failure), muse-glimmer (95% failure), and mistral-nemo (44% failure).

How we'll implement it:
1. Identify stable free alternatives for the 3b and 12b tiers

tasks.title: Debug vault.read and github.get_file permissions
tasks.detail:
Intermittent step failures in vault.read (2/3) and github.get_file (1/1) are causing hidden retries and latency.

How we'll implement it:
1. Audit filesystem permissions for the Naxie process
2. Check GitHub MCP server token scopes for get_file operations
3. Add detailed error logging to the tool wrapper to capture the exact failure reason
